label: Group 7 integration: assembled assertion branches and registered q.20 love route (#1732)
summary: Issue #1732, baseline 354540f9. Assertion: composed the checked #1414 contentRouteA/contentRouteB with legacyAssertionFromContent at one signature, content semantics, world, content profile and legacy profile (results d18f971b zero-axiom, df21f785 classical) ending at GodAssertsOnlyTruth 5a035a1e, plus joint witness 75e72e5e (selective sample, bearer true, world false, content a, existential erasure): both bundles and representation hold together with an actual legacy assertion. Frontier-diff: support alternatives 524 to 526, open premises 511 unchanged, no bare premise added; these are assemblies of existing support, not new evidence. Representation f221d6c6 stays the shared OPEN input of every branch. Love: registered the PR #1458 DivineLoveBridge composition as zero-axiom results 7209fa2f (willing some good to every existing being) and a2366ca4 (love of every existing being), replacing the classical self/other split by an explicit DecidableEq instance; CausalExistenceWilling a94c5dfc, DivineOwnGoodWilling 2a168a36 and WillingGoodEntailsLove 16ab027e are explicit OPEN premises. Conclusions do not yet feed a root route; consumers named: #1735 (hiddenness perfect/actual love projection), #1733 (recipient goods). Intellect/operation findings classified as weaker inputs (capacity, immanent operation) or requiring new interpretation (cognitive-defect, causal-exemplar). Same-witness consumers of #1750/#1753 use a different world-indexed signature; bearer transport to the Attitudes bearer is an exact missing interface. Rejected: registering the classical originals (zero-axiom policy for non-Mathlib results); a premise-level excluded middle for identity (instance parameter is the honest decidability input); treating the assembled bundles as additional corroboration. Semantic-challenge repairs: ordered-love sibling 1dd68893 with CREATURE_WILLING disambiguation dd7ff973; LOVE disambiguation 28c9980e (LOVE_1 thin q.20, LOVE_2 hiddenness PerfectLove, LOVE_3 love of possessed good) with sense carriers in DivineLoveSenses (closes #1756).
blocker: Assertion: warrant is underdetermined at the moral bridge (beneficial false assertion survives; owners #1439, #1440, #1737) and at divine-cognitive application (actual operation to asserted contingent content; causal-exemplar/eternal-presence proposal untested on one content). Love: the causal-to-recipient-willing application CausalExistenceWilling is the weakest step; natural diffusion / foreseen collateral production survives at fixed effect and target (owner #1459, stopped by owner instruction 2026-11-12). Downstream: no bridge from GodLovesAllExisting to hiddenness love (#1735) and no bearer transport from the same-witness root to the veracity Attitudes bearer.

current_assessment.scope: Group 7 integration: assembled content assertion branches to GodAssertsOnlyTruth and registered recipient-good love route, at the stated bearers.
current_assessment.assessment: Both destinations are formally complete conditional routes. The assertion chain is nonvacuous at one bearer, world and content profile, sharing the OPEN representation bridge; neither branch is better warranted overall, and its warrant stays underdetermined at the beneficial-false-assertion and divine-cognitive-application bridges. The love route is a coherent conditional support option with a comparatively well-supported self-good bridge and a prima facie plausible thin love-meaning bridge (subject to the q.20 a.2 ad 3 qualification) and one open application bridge (causal existence to recipient-directed willing), against the surviving natural-diffusion / foreseen-collateral alternative. No premise established, no rival defeated. The q.20 a.2 ad 3 ordered-love reading is registered as sibling statement 1dd68893 (disambiguation dd7ff973), a source-internal reading of the causal-willing step for non-rational effects incompatible there with a94c5dfc. The love result proves LOVE_1 (disambiguation 28c9980e) only.
current_assessment.next_test: Assertion: apply a defended non-overridable assertoric-responsibility principle, or a calibrated operation-to-content bridge for one asserted contingent content, to the same GOD_4. Love: an independently supported account of divine practical specification of each effect compared with whole-order adoption including foreseen collateral effects (requires a new #1459 assignment). Integration: bearer transport from the same-witness root to the veracity bearer; love projection owned by #1735.
current_assessment.evidence: PR-1755; issue #1732; companion note docs/notes/divine-love-goodness-bridge.md#group-7-integration-recipient-good-route-1732-2026-11-18. First proposed delivery cf1c177fc21ca7b097b5c92761bcceb64ccc236e. The coordinator's independent semantic challenge originally found 1 P1 and 4 P2 (P2-5 was the LOVE disambiguation). The repairs in c74f66eadc, with P2-5 delivered in 335a89a10a, were accepted on re-check. The re-check of the 335a89a10a delta leaves 1 P1 open: sibling 1dd68893 builds in an exclusive denial that q.20 a.2 ad 3 does not state, yet it is presented as the ad 3 reading. It also leaves 2 P2 open: the sense carriers are not tied to the registered parametric theorems, and disambiguation links are missing on 16ab027e, e3d5bece and c691e3d0. These are to be repaired in a follow-up PR under #1732. Codex re-review of 335a89a10a found no major issues; CI green. Merged in PR #1755 at merge commit c9b9b661ac7609f8e824da8708dce19716033e59 (2026-11-18). Convention: reviewed_revision is the head that the final review covered. Acceptance covers the qualified synthesis only; no premise establishment, rival defeat or closure.
